title: Bucketlistt.com Secures ₹7.6 Crore Seed Funding to Expand Travel Experiences and Booking Technology in India
summary: Bucketlistt.com secures ₹7.6 crore seed funding to expand travel booking technology
detailed: Ahmedabad-based travel-tech startup Bucketlistt.com has raised ₹7.6 crore in a seed funding round led by Kairon Capital , with participation from Titan Capital, Divisa Family Office and Kunal Popat.
Bucketlistt plans to use the investment to expand its travel experiences marketplace, improve its technology and bring more local activity operators onto its platforms.
Bucketlistt.com and OkGhumo together handled more than ₹22.5 crore in bookings during the first 10 months of the business’s operations .
The latest investment follows an earlier pre-seed funding round of ₹1.07 crore backed by angel investors Arvind Choudhar, Aenik Shah, Kartik Khatri and Yash Mehta.
sentences: Ahmedabad-based travel-tech startup Bucketlistt.com has raised ₹7.6 crore in a seed funding round led by Kairon Capital , with participation from Titan Capital, Divisa Family Office and Kunal Popat.
Bucketlistt plans to use the investment to expand its travel experiences marketplace, improve its technology and bring more local activity operators onto its platforms.

The funding will support Bucketlistt.com’s expansion into additional Indian destinations, including Manali and Bir, as it develops a business that serves both travellers looking for activities and local operators managing bookings.

Founded in 2025 by Shubham Makhecha, Nitant Desai and Divyam Shah , Bucketlistt.com enables travellers to discover and book verified activities ranging from outdoor adventures to cultural and dining experiences.

The venture started its operation in December 2025 at Rishikesh and has since then created a marketplace where one can purchase experiences like adventure sports at Mount Abu, Ganga Aarti at Rishikesh and delicious food experiences in Jaipur.
Beyond its consumer marketplace, Bucketlistt.com is building technology for businesses that provide these experiences.
Its operator-focused platform, OkGhumo, launched in March 2026 , helps travel activity providers manage reservations, inventory, agent networks and payments.
The software is designed to replace manual processes involving phone calls, WhatsApp conversations and spreadsheets with a more organised booking system.
OkGhumo also provides live inventory management, allowing operators to confirm reservations based on available capacity.
This combination of a customer-facing booking marketplace and business management software forms a central part of Bucketlistt.com’s expansion strategy.
Bucketlistt.com and OkGhumo together handled more than ₹22.5 crore in bookings during the first 10 months of the business’s operations .
Bucketlistt.com has served over 12,000 customers, while OkGhumo has served more than 50,000 customers, according to the company.
Around 20% of Bucketlistt.com’s customers reportedly arrive through word-of-mouth referrals.
The latest investment follows an earlier pre-seed funding round of ₹1.07 crore backed by angel investors Arvind Choudhar, Aenik Shah, Kartik Khatri and Yash Mehta.
With the new capital, the startup intends to strengthen product development, establish content and distribution partnerships, and expand its network of experience providers across India.
Bucketlistt.com operates in a market that includes international travel activity booking platforms such as Klook, GetYourGuide and Viator, alongside Indian competitors including Alyve.

As it enters more destinations, the company is seeking to grow both sides of its business: helping travellers find and reserve local experiences while giving activity operators digital tools to manage their services.
Its next stage of expansion will depend on adding more destinations and operators while improving the technology supporting bookings across both platforms.
